notes.title: Version 2.0 Update - Major Update
notes.content:
Version 2.0 Update

Now Supports Ray Tracing!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45366367/6c9ee52088058d36d067c0672c2b696fc7fe6be4.jpg
⬇️Update Details⬇️

[olist]
New Mode: No-Save Challenge - Find and illuminate all the "Purple Crystals" on the map without any save points. As night falls and darkness sets in, locate and light up the "Orange Crystals" in advance.

New Portal Mechanism: Unlock the portal by exploring the map and lighting up all the "Purple Crystals."

Random Weather: Rain, snow, wind, fog, thunderstorms, clear skies, auroras, and rainbows.

Day-Night Cycle: Sunrise, sunset, brightness, and darkness.

Seasonal Changes: Spring, summer, autumn, and winter. By default, the in-game season matches the real-world season.

Map Remastered and Upgraded: The Ruins.

Improved game music and sound effects.

Added beginner tutorials and tips.

Optimized character animations and controls.

Adjusted platform difficulty for better balance.

Fixed several known bugs.
[/olist]
